pure-announcement.rationale: An essay articulating a development framework, with no product, release, or funding being announced.

duplicate.rationale: None of the nearest concepts (context layer, MCP platform notes, W2S sandbox) cover nested feedback loops for agentic product development.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The letter itself is the primary source for a named practitioner framework whose mechanism — three loops at distinct cadences — a reader can inspect and apply.

durability.rationale: The structural pattern — a fast self-testing agent loop nested inside a developer steering loop nested inside slow external feedback, with human involvement justified by an information asymmetry rather than 'taste' — ages independently of the buzzword that prompted it.

actionability.rationale: It tells a builder concretely how to work: close the inner loop with evals and self-testing, shift personal time from QA to product decisions, and add evals when the agent repeatedly hits the same failure.

atomicity.rationale: One core idea — three nested loops at different timescales govern agentic product development — with the context-advantage point serving as the rationale for the middle loop.
